sources.title: Source token and weighted aggregate derivation
sources.details: For source s with n_s records and l_s valid labels, T_s=n_s*l_s and r_s=T_s/sumT. 20*n_long/(n_short+20*n_long)=1/10 implies n_short=180*n_long. Unweighted CE over fixed290 positions is (sumshortNLL+sumlongNLL)/290; position share200/290 alone cannot specify summed-NLL share. Custom factor a_s changes weighted objective terms, not T_s. A pooled average can improve while a minor component worsens; recommending per-source evaluation is accounting guidance, not an achieved model outcome.
